exposure: maternal COVID-19 infection status (hospitalized, outpatient, common cold, noninfected)
cohort: 192 pregnant women in their second or third trimester, categorized into four groups based on their COVID-19 infection history.
finding: Moderate maternal COVID-19 infection, particularly in hospitalized women, significantly decreased fetal diaphragmatic excursion and was associated with a higher NICU admission rate.
gest_age: Second or third trimester, with ultrasound examinations performed at 32 to 37 weeks of gestation.
